serverMessages.WD_CHOOSE_SUBJECT: Choose an animal or a herd first.
serverMessages.WD_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this treatment. It may have been removed. Refresh the list and try again.
serverMessages.WD_DATE_INVALID: That date is not valid. Choose a date from the calendar.
serverMessages.WD_LAST_DOSE_BEFORE_START: The last dose cannot be before the treatment started. Choose a later day.
serverMessages.WD_LAST_DOSE_TOO_FAR: That last dose date is too far ahead. Choose today or an earlier day.
serverMessages.WD_NAME_REQUIRED: Write the name of the medicine, as it is on the label.
serverMessages.WD_ONE_SUBJECT: Choose one animal or one herd, not both.
serverMessages.WD_SUBJECT_NOT_ON_FARM: That animal or herd is not on this farm. Choose one from this farm's list.
serverMessages.WD_START_IN_FUTURE: The treatment cannot start in the future. Choose today or an earlier day.
serverMessages.WD_DAYS_REQUIRED: How many days was it given? Enter a number of days, 1 or more.
serverMessages.WD_LABEL_DAYS_REQUIRED: Enter the milk / egg days and the meat days from the label. Enter 0 if the label says none.
serverMessages.WD_TREATMENT_UNLINKED: This treatment is no longer linked to an animal or herd, so it cannot be changed here.
serverMessages.WD_ONLY_OWNER_EDITS: Only the owner of this animal can change its treatment record. Ask the owner to do it.
serverMessages.WD_VET_ONLY_LIST: This list is only for vets.
serverMessages.WD_GROUP_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this herd. It may have been removed.
serverMessages.RX_ONE_SUBJECT: A prescription is for one animal or one herd, not both.
serverMessages.RX_SUBJECT_REQUIRED: Choose the animal or herd this prescription is for. This appointment has none linked to it.
serverMessages.RX_ANIMAL_NOT_PATIENTS: You can prescribe only for an animal that belongs to this patient, or one you already have an appointment for. Choose one of the owner's animals.
serverMessages.RX_GROUP_NOT_BOOKED: You can prescribe for a herd only when you are booked or in consultation for it. Ask the farm owner to book you.
serverMessages.RX_TREATMENT_DAYS_REQUIRED: {{label}}: enter how many days the treatment lasts.
serverMessages.RX_LABEL_DAYS_REQUIRED: {{label}}: enter the milk / egg days and the meat days from the product label, or choose "None". The farm needs this to know when milk and meat are safe.
serverMessages.RX_START_INVALID: The course start day is not a valid date.
serverMessages.RX_START_RANGE: The course start day must be within the last 30 days or the next 14 days.
serverMessages.PH_KIND_INVALID: Choose medicine, diet or supplement as the product kind.
serverMessages.PH_DAYS_INVALID: Withdrawal days must be a whole number from 0 to 365, as printed on the product label. Leave it empty if you do not know.
serverMessages.PH_LINE_REQUIRED: Say which prescription line this is.
serverMessages.PH_PRODUCT_INVALID: Choose one of the products in your catalogue.
serverMessages.PH_PRODUCT_MISSING: That product is not in your network's catalogue. Add it in the Catalogue tab first.
serverMessages.FORBIDDEN_ROLE: Your account does not have access to this action. If you need it, ask the owner or an administrator to give you the right role.
serverMessages.RX_NETWORK_NOT_MEMBER: You can send a prescription to a hospital network's pharmacy only if you belong to that network. Choose one of your own networks, or send it without one.
serverMessages.WD_FARM_TEAM_ONLY: Only the people who run this farm can change its treatment record. Ask the farm owner or a manager to do it.
serverMessages.WI_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this invitation. Check the link, or ask the hospital to send a new one.
serverMessages.WI_USED: This invitation has already been used or cancelled. Ask the hospital if you need a new one.
serverMessages.WI_EXPIRED: This invitation has expired. Ask the hospital to send you a new one.
serverMessages.HN_TRANSFER_FORBIDDEN: Your role in this network cannot move patients between hospitals. Ask a hospital director or the network admin.
serverMessages.HN_HOSPITAL_NOT_IN_NETWORK: Both hospitals must belong to this network. Choose the hospitals from the list.
serverMessages.HN_SAME_HOSPITAL: The patient is already at that hospital. Choose a different hospital to move them to.
serverMessages.HN_ANIMAL_NOT_PATIENT: That animal is not an active patient of this network. Choose a patient from the network's patient list.
serverMessages.HN_NOT_AT_HOSPITAL: That patient is not at the hospital you chose to move them from. Open the patient to see where they are now.
serverMessages.HN_TRANSFER_OPEN: This patient already has a transfer waiting. Complete or cancel it before starting another.
serverMessages.HN_TRANSFER_CLOSED: This transfer is already finished or cancelled, so it cannot be completed again.
serverMessages.HN_TRANSFER_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this transfer. It may have been removed. Refresh the list.
serverMessages.HN_TRANSFER_FIELDS: Choose the patient, the hospital they move from, the hospital they move to, and give the reason for the move.
serverMessages.HN_NETWORK_SUSPENDED: This network has been suspended, so no one new can be added. Contact platform support.
serverMessages.HN_SEAT_LIMIT: Your plan allows {{limit}} people and {{used}} are already in this network. Ask the platform admin to upgrade the plan, or remove someone first.
serverMessages.HN_PLAN_IN_USE: This plan is in use by one or more networks. Move them to another plan first, or hide the plan instead.
serverMessages.HN_NOT_MEMBER: You are not a member of this network, so you cannot see its transfers. Ask the network admin to add you.
serverMessages.NUT_AGE_REQUIRED: Add this animal's date of birth first (an estimate is fine). A ration depends on its age, and a young animal must not be fed like an adult.
serverMessages.NUT_HOME_DIET_YOUNG: A growing animal under a year old cannot be fed home-cooked food alone: it needs a complete food made for its age. Add a complete food to the plan, or ask a vet for a diet.
serverMessages.NUT_NO_RATION_REQUIREMENTS_ARE_SET: No ration requirements are set up for this kind of animal yet. An admin can add them in Nutrition data.
serverMessages.NUT_CHOOSE_THE_FEEDS_YOU_HAVE: Choose the feeds you have - at least one fodder and one concentrate.
serverMessages.NUT_A_RATION_CAN_USE_UP: A ration can use up to 25 feeds.
serverMessages.NUT_ONE_OF_THE_CHOSEN_FEEDS: One of the chosen feeds is no longer available. Choose it again.
serverMessages.NUT_AVERAGE_WEIGHT_MUST_BE_BETWEEN: Average weight must be between 1 and 2000 kg.
serverMessages.NUT_THIS_GROUP_HAS_NO_ANIMALS: This group has no animals in it yet. Add animals to the group first.
serverMessages.NUT_MILK_PER_DAY_MUST_BE: Milk per day must be between 0 and 200 litres.
serverMessages.NUT_MILK_FAT_MUST_BE_BETWEEN: Milk fat must be between 0 and 15%.
serverMessages.NUT_THESE_FEEDS_CANNOT_MEET_THE: These feeds cannot meet the needs yet.
serverMessages.NUT_NOT_FOUND: We could not find that. It may have been removed, or you may not have access to it. Refresh the screen and try again.
serverMessages.NUT_THAT_DATE_OF_BIRTH_IS: That date of birth is not a valid date.
serverMessages.NUT_DATE_OF_BIRTH_CANNOT_BE: Date of birth cannot be in the future.
serverMessages.NUT_ACTIVITY_MUST_BE_LOW_MODERATE: Activity must be low, moderate, high or working.
serverMessages.NUT_CHOOSE_WHERE_THE_ANIMAL_IS: Choose where the animal is kept from the list.
serverMessages.NUT_NOTHING_TO_SAVE_CHOOSE_AT: Nothing to save - choose at least one answer.
serverMessages.NUT_THAT_DATE_IS_IN_THE: That date is in the future. Choose today or an earlier day.
serverMessages.NUT_A_PLAN_CAN_HAVE_UP: A plan can have up to 12 foods.
serverMessages.NUT_EACH_FOOD_NEEDS_A_SHARE: Each food needs a share between 1 and 100%.
serverMessages.NUT_ONE_OF_THE_CHOSEN_FOODS: One of the chosen foods is no longer available. Choose it again.
serverMessages.NUT_ENERGY_PER_100_G_MUST: Energy per 100 g must be between 1 and 1000 kcal. Check the food label.
serverMessages.NUT_FOR_CATTLE_BUFFALO_GOATS_SHEEP: For cattle, buffalo, goats, sheep, horses and donkeys, use "Work out a ration" - it balances the feeds you have.
serverMessages.NUT_A_FOOD_CALCULATOR_FOR_THIS: A food calculator for this kind of animal is not available yet. The safe-food guide, weight and body condition tracking work now.
serverMessages.NUT_CHOOSE_A_GOAL_FROM_THE: Choose a goal from the list.
serverMessages.NUT_THIS_PLAN_HAS_BEEN_REPLACED: This plan has been replaced by a newer one. Review the current plan instead.
serverMessages.NUT_FOR_A_FARM_RATION_CHANGE: For a farm ration, change the feeds or limits and save a new ration instead of setting the energy by hand.
serverMessages.NUT_THE_DAILY_ENERGY_MUST_BE: The daily energy must be a number above zero.
serverMessages.NUT_THIS_IS_MORE_THAN_25: This is more than 25% away from the calculated amount. Add a short reason so the owner and the next vet can see why.
serverMessages.NUT_ONLY_A_VET_CAN_PRESCRIBE: Only a vet can prescribe a diet.
serverMessages.NUT_THIS_PLAN_HAS_BEEN_REPLACED_2: This plan has been replaced by a newer one. Prescribe the current plan instead.
serverMessages.NUT_THIS_PLAN_IS_ALREADY_PRESCRIBED: This plan is already prescribed. Make a new plan to prescribe a different diet.
serverMessages.NUT_THIS_PLAN_HAS_NO_FOODS: This plan has no foods to prescribe.
serverMessages.NUT_THIS_ANIMAL_HAS_NO_OWNER: This animal has no owner on record, so a prescription cannot be written for it.
serverMessages.NUT_THAT_APPOINTMENT_IS_NOT_YOURS: That appointment is not yours or is for another animal. Prescribe the diet from this animal's own consultation.
serverMessages.NUT_FEED_FOR_FARM_ANIMALS_IS: Feed for farm animals is recorded in Daily records - open Daily records, choose this animal or group, and tap Feed.
serverMessages.NUT_FEEDING_CAN_BE_RECORDED_FOR: Feeding can be recorded for the last 30 days only.
serverMessages.NUT_THAT_FOOD_IS_NOT_IN: That food is not in this animal's plan.
serverMessages.NUT_THAT_FOOD_IS_NO_LONGER: That food is no longer available. Choose it again.
serverMessages.NUT_AMOUNT_MUST_BE_A_NUMBER: Amount must be a number of grams, zero or more.
serverMessages.NUT_ENERGY_MUST_BE_A_NUMBER: Energy must be a number, zero or more.
serverMessages.NUT_ONLY_THE_PERSON_WHO_ENTERED: Only the person who entered this, or the animal's owner, can delete it.
serverMessages.NUT_GIVE_THE_FOOD_A_NAME: Give the food a name, as it is written on the pack.
serverMessages.NUT_THIS_PART_OF_NUTRITION_IS: This part of nutrition is not included in your plan yet.
serverMessages.ANIMAL_NO_ACCESS: You can't open this animal's records. They are shared only with the owner, their farm team, a vet who has an appointment for the animal, and a hospital the owner has shared them with. Check you opened the right animal, or ask the owner to share it with you.
serverMessages.NUT_NO_ACCESS: This animal's food and body condition are shared only with its owner, their farm team, and a vet who has an appointment for it (and for 30 days after). Ask the owner to book you, or to add you to their farm team.
serverMessages.NUT_READ_ONLY: You can see this animal's food plan but not change it. Ask the owner or the farm manager if something needs to change.
serverMessages.NUT_REVIEW_ONLY_VET: Only a vet can review a food plan. The plan stays a suggestion until a vet looks at it.
serverMessages.NUT_FACTS_NEEDED: A few details are needed first: {{facts}}.
serverMessages.NUT_ENERGY_NO_WEIGHT: A current weight is needed to work out daily food.
serverMessages.NUT_ENERGY_NEEDS_TARGET_WEIGHT: To plan weight loss, add a body condition score or a target weight.
serverMessages.NUT_ENERGY_NO_FACTOR: The energy rules for this animal are not set up yet. An admin can add them in Nutrition data.
serverMessages.NUT_PLAN_ALLERGY: This plan includes a food this animal is recorded as allergic to ({{foods}}). Remove it and save again, or ask the vet.
serverMessages.NUT_PLAN_UNSAFE: This plan includes a food that is unsafe for this animal ({{foods}}). Remove it and save again.
serverMessages.NUT_REQ_INCOMPLETE: The ration requirements "{{title}}" are incomplete ({{gaps}}). An admin can complete them in Nutrition data.
serverMessages.NUT_GROWING_REQ_INCOMPLETE: The growing-stock requirements "{{title}}" are incomplete (target gain / energy per kg gain). An admin can complete them in Nutrition data.
serverMessages.NUT_HERD_READ_ONLY: You can see this herd's ration but not change it. Ask the owner or the farm manager if something needs to change.
serverMessages.NUT_FEED_NOT_FOR_ANIMAL: {{label}} is not a feed for this kind of animal. Choose another feed.
serverMessages.NUT_FEED_UNSAFE: {{label}} is not safe for this animal ({{danger}}). Take it out and choose another feed.
serverMessages.NUT_FEED_COPPER: {{label}} has too much copper for this animal ({{cu}} mg per kg). Take it out and choose another feed.
serverMessages.NUT_FEED_NO_VALUES: {{label}} has no feed values (dry matter, energy, protein) yet, so it cannot be used in a ration.
serverMessages.NUT_FEED_NO_HORSE_VALUES: {{label}} has no horse feed values (dry matter, energy, protein) yet, so it cannot be used in a horse ration.
serverMessages.NUT_RATION_MODEL_HERD: A herd ration is for cattle, buffalo, goats, sheep, camels, horses and donkeys. For poultry, pigs and fish use the daily feed card.
serverMessages.NUT_RATION_MODEL_ANIMAL: The ration calculator is for cattle, buffalo, goats, sheep, camels, horses and donkeys.
serverMessages.NUT_WEIGHT_NEEDED_HERD: Type the herd's average weight (a weighing band estimate is fine) - no weights are recorded for its animals yet.
serverMessages.NUT_WEIGHT_NEEDED_ANIMAL: A current weight is needed first. Add it on the Body tab (a weighing band estimate is fine).
serverMessages.NEEDS_VET_HORSE_GROUP: The young horses in this group are still growing (under {{months}} months). A growing horse needs a feeding plan from a vet - book a consultation.
serverMessages.NEEDS_VET_HORSE_ANIMAL: This horse is still growing (under {{months}} months). A growing horse needs a feeding plan from a vet - book a consultation.
serverMessages.NEEDS_VET_STOCK_GROUP: The young animals in this group are still on milk and starter feed (under {{months}} months). A fodder ration is not right for them yet - ask your vet for a calf feeding plan.
serverMessages.NEEDS_VET_STOCK_ANIMAL: This animal is still on milk and starter feed (under {{months}} months). A fodder ration is not right for them yet - ask your vet for a calf feeding plan.
serverMessages.NUT_RATION_CANNOT_MEET_ANIMAL: These feeds cannot meet the animal's needs yet. Follow the suggestions on screen, then save.
serverMessages.NUT_RATION_CANNOT_MEET_HERD: These feeds cannot meet the herd's needs yet. Follow the suggestions on screen, then save.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_BCS_HIGH: {{name}} is carrying too much weight. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_BCS_LOW: {{name}} is too thin. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_MUSCLE_LOSS: {{name}} is losing muscle. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_RAPID_WEIGHT_LOSS: {{name}} is losing weight fast. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_WEIGHT_DRIFT: {{name}} has changed weight. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_NO_RECENT_WEIGHT: {{name}} has not been weighed lately. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_TREATS_OVER_LIMIT: {{name}} is getting too many treats. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_UNSAFE_FOOD: {{name}} was given a food that is not safe for it. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_TRANSITION_LOSS: {{name}} lost body condition after giving birth. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_FEED_BELOW: {{name}} is being fed less than the table amount. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_FEED_ABOVE: {{name}} is being fed more than the table amount. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_FLAG_OTHER: {{name}} needs a look. Open Nutrition to see what to do.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_PLAN_BODY: A new feeding plan for {{name}} is waiting for a vet to check it. Open Nutrition and use Review.
serverMessages.NOTIF_WD_MILK_MEAT: {{name}} was treated - hold back milk and eggs through {{milk}}, meat through {{meat}}. Open Daily records to see what is under withdrawal.
serverMessages.NOTIF_WD_MILK: {{name}} was treated - hold back milk and eggs through {{milk}}. Open Daily records to see what is under withdrawal.
serverMessages.NOTIF_WD_MEAT: {{name}} was treated - hold back meat through {{meat}}. Open Daily records to see what is under withdrawal.
serverMessages.NOTIF_WI_BODY: {{patient}} accepted the invitation to {{network}}. You can now ask to enrol {{pet}}; they will be asked to approve sharing.
serverMessages.NOTIF_TRANSFER_BODY: {{name}}'s care has moved to {{to}} in the same network. Your consent and records stay as they were.
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_PLAN_OWNER_TITLE: Feeding plan waiting for a vet: {{name}}
serverMessages.NOTIF_NUT_PLAN_OWNER_BODY: The new feeding plan for {{name}} is waiting for a vet to approve it. The plan already in use stays as it is until then. If you have no vet yet, book one.
